details:
- CVE-2026-53783: rrsync restricted-directory escape through a symlinked or
  raced path component, --copy-unsafe-links, -D or a symlinked log file;
  partial, the dir-merge rule escape needs --confine-root (3.5.0)
- CVE-2026-53790: command and argument injection in the daemon's expand_vars()
  hook expansion, in RSYNC_CONNECT_PROG and in the remote-shell argument
  escape
- CVE-2026-70453: CPU denial of service in hash_search() -- unbounded walk of
  the same-weak-checksum chain at every file offset
- CVE-2026-70458: out-of-bounds write in recv_file_entry() -- FLAG_HLINKED was
  accepted without the hard-link extra slots having been reserved
- CVE-2026-70462: peer-controlled MSG_IO_TIMEOUT disabled --timeout or
  overflowed set_io_timeout() into a busy select() loop that pegs a CPU
- CVE-2026-70464: pre-auth connection-slot exhaustion -- the daemon handshake
  ran with no I/O timeout while claim_connection() had already taken a
  max-connections slot
- safe_arg() left an uninitialized heap byte in remote-shell filename args
- hash_search() --inplace catch-up advanced aligned_i past s->count, a 32-bit
  overflow into a negative basis index on source files over 2 GiB (no CVE)
- hash_search() took the adjacent want_i block on its checksums alone, without
  checking its length (no CVE)
